note: Zone of the B23 auto-école (R_road_02): La terrasse sur la rocade, the sunny roof terrace of the garage (honey-cream stone walls, terracotta-tile floor, iron railings, geraniums), looking out over the curving ring road, a river with an old stone bridge and green hills. Landmark: the ring road sweeping away below the railings. Feminine LEFT: white goose in goggles honking in a little red pedal car (automobiliste). Masculine RIGHT: chauffeur in white gloves on a small podium conducting the traffic below with a baton (conducteur); film star in sunglasses signing autographs from the window of a small red vintage bus (autobus); gentleman on a penny-farthing riding round in circles (cycle); merman in a tin bath holding up a blank round SLOW paddle while tortoises crawl past (ralentissement); man combing his hair with a giant comb, sitting on a heap of suitcases and boxes (encombrement); station master with a whistle by a parked black car and an old parking meter (stationnement); old lady resident watering her window box above a little garden stream (riverain); bike-hire man with a rack of rental bikes and a fishing rod with a bright lure (loueur). Exit: the glazed French doors at left -> back into the loft R_road_02. Edge notes: the riverain lady leans out of a window at the right frame edge and the rental bikes reach the bottom-right corner; boxes are clipped to the safe area (figures stay in frame). Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p4).
